cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: oc auth can-i create operatorgroups.operators.coreos.com -n openshift-operators; oc auth can-i patch installplans.operators.coreos.com -n openshift-operators
oc get packagemanifest openshift-cert-manager-operator -n openshift-marketplace -o jsonpath='{range .status.channels[?(@.name=="stable-v1")].entries[*]}{.name}{"\n"}{end}'
oc get packagemanifest openshift-cert-manager-operator -n openshift-marketplace -o jsonpath='{range .status.channels[?(@.name=="stable-v1.19")].entries[*]}{.name}{"\n"}{end}'
